title: Agent Pulse
description: One daily evidence-backed decision brief from the coding-agent projects monitored by The Git Reporter.

scope.coverageStatement: V0.2 reports one dated decision brief from direct public source evidence and keeps git motion as a secondary measurement layer. Community feedback metrics are absent until a reproducible feedback collector ships.

inputs.dailyInsight: reported, date-owned Agent Pulse decision brief

editorialRead.headline: Morning Read — October 20, 2026
editorialRead.readHeadline: aaif-goose/goose is the first source to inspect.
editorialRead.oneLineSummary: aaif-goose/goose leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: aaif-goose/goose — 7 commits today, 1.7 above its current daily pace, with 9 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
openclaw/openclaw — 194 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
OpenHands/OpenHands — No same-day commit after 80 commits in the seven-day window. The pause is notable enough to preserve, not enough to turn into a story.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: CrewAI evaluation can run the work before grading it
dailyInsight.insight: October 19 merged code lets crewai eval execute a project when no current traced run exists, then send that run for grading. The inspected October 14 release predates the change.
dailyInsight.mechanism: The command detects absent or stale run records. First tracing enable asks at a terminal; without one it can persist tracing=true with notice. Explicit tracing-off and trusted AMP-origin checks constrain execution.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: An agent invoking evaluation may now perform the project’s work and change its tracing configuration. Operators need to include both execution effects and trace destination in an upgrade trial.

actions.label: Watch for a containing release and rehearse on a disposable project
actions.instruction: Before upgrading automation, compare a fresh project, an existing traced run and an explicitly tracing-disabled project. Use harmless tools and inspect the resulting configuration, run record and trace destination. Keep a copy for rollback.
actions.effort: One bounded trial after release containment is confirmed

receipts.title: Execute and evaluate when no current traced run exists
receipts.supports: Implements rerun selection, terminal/nonterminal tracing behavior and trusted-origin guards.

receipts.title: Evaluation workflow change and reviewed boundaries
receipts.supports: Documents the prior untraced-run obstacle, final consent behavior, tests and older-runtime limits.

confidence.basis: Merged implementation, prior source history, test definitions, PR and latest release metadata inspected.

dailyInsight.limitation: No live crew, trace upload or grading service was exercised. No containing release established; older project runtimes can still fail to record a usable trace. An evaluation verdict does not establish production correctness.
dailyInsight.falsifier: A containing release keeps no-current-run evaluation passive, or a pinned harmless trial contradicts the documented tracing and origin checks.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A containing release and reproducible disposable-project run showing execution, persisted tracing choice and the evaluated run identity.
